candidates.description: This vector represents various Hindi consonant conjuncts, vowel signs, and numbers extracted from Devanagari script text processing.
This feature vector represents the Devanagari script, specifically focusing on characters containing the consonant 'भ' (bha).
These tokens are common fragments and words in the Hindi language written in the Devanagari script.
This vector is related to Hindi vowel matras combined with punctuation marks.
This vector represents common Hindi sub-word suffixes and character n-grams.
This vector represents Devanagari vowel signs and inflectional suffixes common in Hindi word endings.
This vector activates strongly for common Devanagari script characters and phonetic prefixes, particularly those starting with the vowel 'अ' (a).
This vector represents variations of the Devanagari character 'ग' (ga) combined with various vowel signs and matras.
This feature vector represents Devanagari script characters, conjunct consonants, and related Indic language sub-word tokens.
This vector activates for common sub-word tokens and character fragments in Hindi text.
